title: NanoBook AI Cost Studies (2026-11-05)
description:
Four small CSV tables (874 data rows total, plus one header row per file) produced by the AI cost calculators on NanoBook. Study date: 2026-11-05 (VRAM model metadata checked 2026-11-04). All values are calculated, not measured. No model was run, no API was called, and no bill was checked.

  • vram-model-quant-context-2026-11-05.csv (100 rows: 90 calculated, 10 unavailable exact Ollama tag) — Estimated GPU memory for 5 local LLM models (Llama 3.2 3B Instruct, Qwen3 4B, Qwen3 8B, Qwen2.5 7B Instruct, Qwen2.5-Coder 7B Instruct) across 4 weight formats (Q4_K_M, Q5_K_M, Q8_0, FP16) and 5 context lengths (2,048 to 32,768 tokens), using GGUF file size as a weight proxy, F16 KV cache for 1 sequence, and a fixed uncalibrated 1.5 GiB planning allowance.
  • claude-cache-break-even-2026-11-05.csv (720 rows) — Calculated cost comparison of no prompt cache vs. 5-minute TTL cache vs. 1-hour TTL cache across Claude models, request counts, and request gaps using official published token pricing as inputs.
  • rag-average-length-comparison-2026-11-05.csv (45 rows) — Calculated error from estimating RAG chunk counts using an average document length instead of per-document lengths across synthetic document mixes and chunk/overlap settings.
  • rag-document-lengths-2026-11-05.csv (9 rows) — The synthetic document length mixes used as inputs by the RAG length study.
